description.en: The IDs of the destination Nodes.

description.zh: 快照的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the destination Snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the destination Snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
The ID of the source Snapshot.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens copy-snapshot --snapshot-id sp-bp1c0doj0taqyzzl0000 --destination-region-ids cn-hangzhou-26,cn-hangzhou-27 --destination-snapshot-name testSnapshotName --destination-snapshot-description testDescription --instance-billing-cycle example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CopySnapshot --region cn-hangzhou --SnapshotId 'sp-bp1c0doj0taqyzzl0000' --DestinationSnapshotName testSnapshotName --DestinationRegionIds '["cn-hangzhou-26,cn-hangzhou-27"]' --DestinationSnapshotDescription testDescription --InstanceBillingCycle 'example-string'
